song.author: NEEDTOBREATHE feat. Carly Pearce
song.title: Fall On Me
song.lyrics:
[V1] .A E You were there to pick me up and tell me I was good enough . C#m D It doesn't matter what I've done, You pull me closer .A E The highs and lows and in-betweens, You're the one that's there for me . C#m D When I hurt and when I bleed, You make it better .A E You make it better
[C1] . A E C#m D You will always be, You will always be . A The one that I can call . E C#m The safest place to fall . D A For me, when I can't stand . E C#m D When I can't stand
[V2] .A E You always find the best in me, the time is hiding underneath . C#m D Every insecurity that I can't cover .A E I can leave them at the door, You never need me to be more . C#m D Than who I am if I am yours .A E I am yours now
[B1] . A When you feel a little lost now . E Don't remember who you are now . C#m You can run into my arms . D You can fall, you can fall on me . A I ain't ever gonna leave you . E So don't keep another secret . C#m Oh, your tears aren't a weakness . D You can fall, you can fall on me
